name: did-we-drift
description: Project-drift audit for agent-built software, plus /did-we-drift init to start projects audit-ready. Grades two axes separately: the WORK (ON TRACK / DRIFTED (MINOR|MATERIAL|CAPTURED) / INCONCLUSIVE / BLOCKED) and the BASIS it was measured against (RATIFIED / PROVISIONAL / NONE), so a real-but-scattered plan gets a usable verdict instead of a refusal. Init converts a fresh plan into one ratified, provenance-checkable baseline document BEFORE the build starts — the user's finish-line sentence lands in its own commit with their verbatim words, so authorship is provable, not asserted. Classifies every candidate goal USER-RATIFIED / UNKNOWN / AGENT-DRAFTED on mechanical git evidence. Basis recovery for projects that never wrote a plan; a ratified sentence governs FORWARD from its own date. Refuses to certify on-track without an enumerable work map. Grade-gated drift interrupts, snooze-with-memory, transactional repair, run-to-plan binding for /loop and /goal sprints. QUICK single-agent audit by default; contamination-scaled DEEP fan-out when triggers fire.
